2026 FIFA World Cup expanded the tournament format to include 48 teams from six confederations.
2026 FIFA World Cup took place between June 11 and July 19, 2026.
Spain won the 2026 FIFA World Cup final against Argentina with a score of 1–0 after extra time.
Kylian Mbappé of France won the Golden Boot with 10 goals during the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Rodri of Spain was awarded the Golden Ball as the best player of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Unai Simón of Spain received the Golden Glove as the best goalkeeper of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Pau Cubarsí of Spain won the FIFA Young Player Award at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
The Netherlands received the Fair Play Award for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup introduced a new rule requiring players to exit the field within 10 seconds during substitutions.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup introduced mandatory three-minute hydration breaks in every half for all matches.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup generated a record $15 billion in revenue.
